info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Constituents API
info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems
 Email: api@factset.com

item.name: Factset Returns the Requested Benchmark Constituents and Respective Weights, Price and Market Value.

query.description:
(Required) Benchmark Identifiers. Reference the helper endpoint **/id-list** to get a sample list of valid identifiers. You must be authorized for the `ids` requested, otherwise you will receive an error.

***ids limit** = 1 per request*
Date of holding expressed in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Currency for response.
Calendar of data returned. The default value is FIVEDAY which displays Monday through Friday, regardless of whether there were trading holidays.
